q1.explanationZh: 速度攀岩要用最短的时间爬到墙的最上面，top 就是“顶部”。

evidence.quote: The winner is the one who climbs to the top in the shortest time.

q2.explanationZh: 抱石比赛有四分钟，爬过的路线最多的人赢，所以填 most 和 four。

evidence.quote: They have four minutes to do this.
The winner is the one who climbs the most routes.

q3.explanationZh: 难度攀岩比谁爬得高，一共有六分钟，所以填 high 和 six。

evidence.quote: Climbers try to see how high they can climb on a wall.
They have six minutes to climb.

q4.explanationZh: 第一段说有三个比赛项目：速度、抱石和难度攀岩。

q5.explanationZh: 安全绳只在速度攀岩里提到过，抱石部分没有说，所以我们不知道。

evidence.quote: Climbers move across many routes on a 4-metre wall.

q6.explanationZh: 最后一段说三个项目的排名相乘，分数最低的选手获胜。

evidence.quote: The climbers with the lowest scores win.
